spec.name: GoldSupertrendRSIPullback
spec.hypothesis: Institutional algorithmic execution in XAUUSD heavily relies on dynamic trend-following bands like the Supertrend to scale into positions during macroeconomic drifts. Retail traders often fade these moves or enter too late at extremes, becoming trapped liquidity. By identifying the institutional trend via Supertrend and waiting for retail exhaustion (deep RSI pullbacks) during active London/NY hours, we align with smart money accumulation phases. The losing side consists of counter-trend retail traders who sell into discount zones during uptrends or buy into premium zones during downtrends, getting stopped out as the primary trend resumes.
spec.entry_logic: Long: Supertrend direction is bullish (1) AND RSI(10) drops below 45. Short: Supertrend direction is bearish (-1) AND RSI(10) rises above 55.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss placed at 2.0x ATR(14) distance from entry. Take profit placed at 3.0x ATR(14) distance (1.5R). Position closed immediately if Supertrend flips against the trade direction.
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Protracted low-volatility summer chop where Supertrend flips constantly and RSI oscillates around 50 without reaching pullback thresholds.

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
